summary.interpretation: Error-as-tie bug inflated eta_max effect (errors correlated with high-eta models like Gemini) and suppressed K_eff effect. After correction: K_eff is universally significant (12/12), always positive. Diversity is protective across ALL conditions. Dominance shifts strongly toward Co-dominance (10/12) with no pure eta-dominant conditions remaining.

results_tex_discrepancy.note: The task-provided results.tex Table 1 shows 9/12 eta sig and 7/12 K sig, which differs from the JSON output (11/12 eta, 8/12 K). Conditions differing: mmlu_score_manipulation (tex=both n.s., json=eta sig) and arc_score_manipulation (tex=eta n.s., json=eta sig). The JSON values are used as 'old' baseline since they are the verifiable buggy script output.
